name: Ranger
introduce:
RT-102A Ranger
This innovative heavy ST, a collaboration between Katana and Obsidian, represents their second release in the Arashium Frame series.
With an advanced arashium transmission core and Obsidian technology, it provides pilots seamless access to its neural system for superior control. Its high operational demands restrict usage to a select few, sparking discussions about its elite user base.

30268.name: Integration Mod
30268.SpecificEffects:
When HP is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>80%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>.
Any Arm that suffers overdamage remains undestroyed. Has a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>4</color> turns.

20354.name: Cavalry System
20354.SpecificEffects: When a single weapon is equipped in both hands, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.
